source_hypotheses.required: Preparation-zero obstruction; for completeness positive b<17, square reduced denominator, local squares at 2,3,17 and depths 3,1,2.
source_hypotheses.constructed: Physical b=42rN^2 with the actual parent r and norm tree.
source_hypotheses.justification: The proof establishes positivity, congruences of rho, finite-depth bounds and the simultaneous real bound.

constructed_objects.required: The same normalized pole formula and scalar proxy at the actual points H and R=S-P.
constructed_objects.constructed: W=N replaces 1+N; scalar T=42rN^2; omitted preparation u=42rN and v=0 recover the source preparation.
constructed_objects.justification: The conic coefficient is rho=42r, distinguished from the physical b=rho N^2. This is a new soundness/completeness route, not a witness bijection to old W.

index_domain_coverage.required: All integer inputs for completeness and every rational solution for soundness; final h in the required primary/opposite and continuity congruences.
index_domain_coverage.constructed: beta and r unchanged; h=0 mod Pi^44 M_-, h=1 mod M_+, h=h0 mod L0 with 64m0|L0 and m0|h0.
index_domain_coverage.justification: The source gcd conditions imply compatibility. The modulus is fixed before the contact primes; its dense positive tail meets the chosen nonempty real neighborhood. The proof constructs the source odd squarefree M from the odd support of L0 excluding seven, retains the special ray conditions at 2 and 7, and fixes q, the integer forms, the size bound and the cutoff before invoking the fixed-data theorem.

transition_maps.required: Reconstruct source zero-preparation witnesses and apply the four conics with no deleted zero branch.
transition_maps.constructed: u=rho N, v=0; reverse square absorption divides by proved N>0; factored poles reconstruct the old conics.
transition_maps.justification: The local conic maps are exact. The changed W is justified by separate scalar soundness and a fresh completeness construction.

limiting_object_identity.required: The final shared point, scalar root and pole input must be the ones consumed downstream.
limiting_object_identity.constructed: R is fixed before varying H; the same Tproxy=Re(k_H w_S) is controlled on a neighborhood and a congruence class of H0.
limiting_object_identity.justification: With H0 fixed and R tending to the two real identities, N tends to (A^2+r^-15*B^4)/r and b tends to (42/r)*(A^2+r^-15*B^4)^2. First H0 makes this small; an actual finite R then fixes a neighborhood, and the final compatible progression chooses the actual shared H inside it.

coefficient_conventions.required: Rational coefficients in K=Q(sqrt(2)), normalized unramified valuations, and the original input-fixed diagonal factors.
coefficient_conventions.constructed: A,B,C,D0 are the same rational coefficients; r>0, y=Tproxy/r^16 and kappa=r^-15. The current chain is J3=D0^2+kappa*y^2, J2=C^2+kappa*J3^2, J1=B^2+kappa*J2^2, r*N=A^2+kappa*J1^2.
coefficient_conventions.justification: Both-place proxy and norm parity use the same conventions as the parent. All downstream height constants and the diagonal scaling are retained.

local_conditions.required: Order-31 soundness outside {2,3,5,7,13,17}; preparation at support(42r) union {17}, plus inherited comparison conditions.
local_conditions.constructed: The pole gives v(N)>-R_p/2; the unchanged order-31 chain gives v(Tproxy)>963R_p/32. For integer input, all five leaves at depth >=16R_p+1 on support(r) give v(N)>=16R_p+2; positive leaf depths where r is a unit give v(N)>=2.
local_conditions.justification: rho is 4 mod32, 81 mod243 and 13 mod17; b has the required local squareclasses, depths and square reduced denominator.

exceptional_cases.required: Zero norm leaves, all private pole branches, p=41, and identity exclusions of H and R.
exceptional_cases.constructed: A>0 makes N>0 even if other leaves vanish. Valuation infinity is allowed for zero leaves. The original H and R charts/guards are unchanged.
exceptional_cases.justification: No division by a new possibly zero value is introduced. The retained split-41 proxy proof applies only after both points have been put in the formal group, as before.

downstream_consumption.required: The height proof must receive its original order-31 divisibility, and detector completeness must retain order 45.
downstream_consumption.constructed: Same nonzero integral h and scalar index a-1, same anchor 3^2130, same order-45 / order-12 tests and same root scales.
downstream_consumption.justification: The proof gives v_p(a-1)>=31. The final progression uses Pi^44; roots, scales and real/finite bounds precede contact selection. Finite replay separately checks changed scalar rows and every final coefficient. The raw coordinate allocation is identical. Three scalar rows change and one is deleted; no non-scalar source row changes. A checked free-coordinate omission carries the compiler output to the affine-search input without changing any residual.
